FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThis:
We've had a great and powerful TRAINER grow up on this island.
I bet even you'd know her. It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!
When LORELEI was just a tyke, I taught her about POKéMON.
FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm region overall.
But there is one exception you need to know about.
The ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because of the POKéMON that live in it.
